summary: Frontend-only test of Base Components preview dialog. Logged in via mock auth (user@example.com / password), navigated to /design-system/components/base, verified all 63 rows render with correct status badges, opened all 29 higher-risk ESTABLISHED component previews (Calendar, Chart, Carousel, Command, Resizable, Sidebar, Menubar, Navigation Menu, Select, Dropdown Menu, Dialog, Sheet, Drawer, Input OTP, Popover, Hover Card, Context Menu, Pagination, Scroll Area, Table, Tabs, Tooltip, Toast, Toggle Group, Radio Group, Slider, Switch, Progress, Skeleton) — every one rendered a live preview with child elements and NO 'not implemented' / 'not yet available' text and NO page runtime errors. All 3 PENDING components (Attachment, Bubble, Button Group) show the expected 'not yet available' message. Escape/close cycle works — table stays visible and functional after the full sequence. Status badges verified (Pending superset matches the expected list; no expected-pending missing).
critical_code_review_comments: ComponentsPage.jsx: The fallback text uses two different phrasings ('not implemented yet' vs 'not yet available'). Consider consolidating to a single canonical fallback string to avoid future assertion drift.
componentPreviews.jsx is ~835 lines — approaching the recommended split threshold; consider grouping previews into per-category files (e.g., overlays, forms, data-display) for maintainability.
test_credentials: user@example.com / password (frontend mock auth, per /app/memory/test_credentials.md which is otherwise empty)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 29 higher-risk established previews + 3 pending fallbacks verified end-to-end via Playwright. If new previews are added, extend the high_risk list in the automation script. Note: closing the preview Dialog is safer via clicking the shadcn X close button (last button inside [data-testid=component-preview-dialog]) — Escape sometimes fails when focus is inside interactive preview widgets (e.g., Tooltip trigger).
